note: You are only charged when the response is HTTP 200.

resource.description: One-call EU B2B invoice pre-check before paying or issuing an invoice: live VIES VAT validation (name/address when available), IBAN validation for every IBAN country, VAT-country vs IBAN-country match (a common invoice-fraud signal), optional Spanish NIF/NIE/CIF check, and the due date (issue date + term) moved to the next business day using that country's public holidays, with a Late Payment Directive warning for terms over 60 days. Returns verdict ok/review/fail with reasons. If VIES is down the call still succeeds with vies.status=unavailable and verdict=review. GET with query params or POST a JSON object.

vatNumber.description: EU VAT number with country prefix (VIES: EL for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland), e.g. DE811569869

spanishTaxId.description: Optional Spanish NIF/NIE/CIF to validate (and match against an ES VAT number)

issueDate.description: Optional invoice date YYYY-MM-DD; enables the due-date calculation

paymentTermDays.description: Optional payment term in calendar days (0-365, default 30 when issueDate is given)

country.description: Optional ISO country whose holidays apply to the due date (default: VAT country)

region.description: Optional ISO 3166-2 region for regional holidays, e.g. DE-BY, ES-CT
